summary: A collapsible, searchable list of every wind reference document, where each title opens its citation.
purpose: Lets a reviewer check which source documents back the wind dossier and read the full uploaded report.
why: Reason not stated in the code beyond the on-screen notes. Those say publisher imports do not replace these documents.
how: Starts closed. When opened, loads the register, filters references by the search text, and lists each with its id, title, publisher, link, scope, verification and checked date. Clicking a title opens its citation. A details block shows the full raw report.
inputs: No props. Loads the register when opened.
outputs: A toggle button and, when open, a search box, the reference list, and the raw report.
risks: The full raw report is long and shown as plain text. Search compares the whole text of each reference, so a match can come from a field the user does not see.
debug: If the list stays empty, check the register loading and error messages. If a title will not open, check the reference id. If search matches oddly, that is the whole-text comparison.
